rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a critical assessment of a book, film, play, or other work.

example.jyutping: ni1 pin1 ping4 leon6 se2 dak1 gei2 zung1 hang2

rows.note: Use this for looking over previously learned material in preparation for an exam.

example.english: I need to review tonight because I have an exam tomorrow.
example.traditional: 我今晚要溫習，聽日就考試喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 maan5 jiu3 wan1 zaap6 ting1 jat6 zau6 haau2 si3 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for a court's formal reassessment of a case or government decision.

example.english: The High Court conducted a judicial review of this decision.
example.traditional: 高等法院就呢項決定進行司法覆核。
example.jyutping: gou1 dang2 faat3 jyun2 zau6 ni1 hong6 kyut3 ding6 zeon3 hang4 si1 faat3 fuk1 hat6

rows.note: Use this to critique an artwork or other new work, especially in a published or public review.

example.english: The newspaper published a review of this new film today.
example.traditional: 報紙今日評論咗呢套新戲。
example.jyutping: bou3 zi2 gam1 jat6 ping4 leon6 zo2 ni1 tou3 san1 hei3

rows.note: Use this for an overview or survey of a range of items or available material rather than a critical assessment.

example.english: This report provides a review of the various products on the market.
example.traditional: 呢份報告提供咗市場上各種產品嘅概覽。
example.jyutping: nei1 fan6 bou3 gou3 tai4 gung1 zo2 si5 coeng4 soeng6 gok3 zung2 caan2 ban2 ge3 koi3 laam5

rows.note: This is the all-purpose casual choice for broadly looking over material or approaches.

example.english: I already gave this report a quick review, so you don’t need to explain it again.
example.traditional: 呢份報告我已經睇過，你唔使再講喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ngo5 ji5 ging1 tai2 gwo3 nei5 m4 sai2 zoi3 gong2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when reviewing something leads to correcting, editing, or revising it.

example.english: We need to review the document, revise a few parts, and then send it to the client.
example.traditional: 我哋要先睇返份文件，修改幾處先交畀客。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 sin1 tai2 faan1 fan6 man4 gin6 sau1 goi2 gei2 cyu3 sin1 gaau1 bei2 haak3
